# Royal Oak Family Dental

> > Royal Oak Family Dental provides comprehensive family dentistry services in Oklahoma City, led by Dr. Kandar and Dr. Karim, offering preventive care, cosmetic dentistry, and specialized services for patients of all ages.

Royal Oak Family Dental is a full-service dental practice located in Oklahoma City, OK, serving families and individuals with a focus on preventive care, cosmetic dentistry, and personalized treatment. The practice emphasizes patient comfort and education while maintaining high standards of clinical care.
